why: This is a specific one-week Xenograde Systems lesson sequence and assessment design for a single study, not a reusable instructional element or named product.

This describes a study-specific Solar System resource and three-session implementation for one group of Mauritian primary pupils, rather than a general instructional element or adoptable named product.

This is a reusable, named annotated mathematics dataset for researchers rather than a general instructional element; it extends the existing XES3G5M benchmark resource with LLM-derived concept and prerequisite annotations.
name: XES3G5M-based mathematics dataset with concept and prerequisite dependency annotations
product_description: A research dataset derived from XES3G5M that provides concept labels and concept-based prerequisite dependency annotations for mathematics questions and student problem-solving records.
